content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This is about building a digital commerce stack that doesn't rely on Stripe or Gumroad. It's about using free and open-source tools to create a store that accepts Bitcoin payments and delivers products instantly. With the Sovereign Stack, you get a complete combination of tools that give you full control over your digital store, from hosting to payment processing to product delivery. This means you can set up your store in 48 hours, upload products, and start selling without any platform fees or account restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Sovereign Stack uses a combination of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments to create a store that accepts Bitcoin payments and delivers products instantly. With GitHub Pages, you get free hosting for your store. Cloudflare Workers provide the backend logic for payment processing and product delivery. NOWPayments handles the Bitcoin payments and sends the funds to your wallet. This architecture is highly scalable, secure, and reliable, and it's designed to work seamlessly with Bitcoin payments.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The Sovereign Stack is built for digital creators who want to sell music online and accept Bitcoin payments without relying on Stripe or Gumroad. This includes musicians, producers, and DJs who want to sell their music and merchandise directly to their fans. With the Sovereign Stack, you can set up your store in 48 hours and start selling your music and merchandise without any platform fees or account restrictions.
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, but NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, retaining $921 per month at 100 sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Sovereign Stack consists of six components: GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, NOWPayments, Supabase, Google Drive, and the Complete Builder Kit. GitHub Pages provides free hosting for your store. Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic for payment processing and product delivery. NOWPayments handles the Bitcoin payments and sends the funds to your wallet. Supabase is used for order storage, while Google Drive is used for file delivery. The Complete Builder Kit is a set of blueprints and templates that make it easy to deploy your store in 48 hours.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack today, follow these steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all six blueprints and seven templates; deploy your store using the Sovereign Stack blueprints; upload your products and configure payment processing and product delivery; set up your store's hosting and security; test your store's performance and scalability; and launch your store and start selling your music and merchandise.

Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
